name: Horezu pottery bowl
about: This is traditional Romanian folk pottery from the town of Horezu. Its hand-painted designs are a well-known part of Romania's craft heritage.
tip: Check that the piece is signed by the artist.

name: Traditional Romanian embroidered blouse (ie)
about: The ie is the classic embroidered blouse worn in Romanian folk dress. Its patterned embroidery varies by region and is a common keepsake from Bucharest.
tip: Hand embroidery costs much more than machine embroidery, so ask which one you are buying.
